name: WF-420 — E-Signature Completion & Contract Execution Reconciliation Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const propertyId=String(b.propertyId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const buyerId=String(b.buyerId??'').trim(); const documentId=String(b.documentId??b.assignmentDocumentId??'').trim(); const eventType=String(b.eventType??b.status??'').trim().toLowerCase(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,propertyId,dealId,buyerId,documentId,eventType,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize E-Signature Event').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const d=ctx.deal??{}; const doc=ctx.document??{}; const signatures=Array.isArray(ctx.signatures)?ctx.signatures:[]; const event=input.eventType; const completedEvents=['completed','fully_signed','executed','signed']; const declinedEvents=['declined','rejected','voided','cancelled']; const requiredRoles=['seller','buyer']; const signedRoles=signatures.filter(s=>s.status==='signed'||s.completed===true).map(s=>String(s.role??'').toLowerCase()); const allRequiredSigned=requiredRoles.every(r=>signedRoles.includes(r)); const flags=[]; if(d.status&&['closed','cancelled','disputed'].includes(String(d.status).toLowerCase()))flags.push('deal_protected_state'); if(doc.voided===true)flags.push('document_voided'); if(declinedEvents.includes(event))flags.push('signature_declined_or_voided'); if(!allRequiredSigned)flags.push('required_signatures_incomplete'); if(doc.documentType&&doc.documentType!=='assignment_agreement')flags.push('unexpected_document_type'); const executionStatus=completedEvents.includes(event)&&allRequiredSigned&&!flags.includes('deal_protected_state')&&!flags.includes('document_voided')?'executed':declinedEvents.includes(event)?'failed_or_voided':allRequiredSigned?'pending_reconciliation':'awaiting_signatures'; const nextAction=executionStatus==='executed'?'reconcile_executed_contract_and_release_to_closing':executionStatus==='failed_or_voided'?'route_for_document_recovery_or_reissue':'await_required_signatures'; const idempotencyKey='wf420:'+input.leadId+':'+input.propertyId+':'+input.dealId+':'+input.buyerId+':'+input.documentId+':'+(event||'unknown'); return [{json:{...input,contractExecution:{status:executionStatus,documentId:input.documentId,eventType:event,allRequiredSignaturesComplete:allRequiredSigned,signedRoles:[...new Set(signedRoles)],requiredRoles,executionEvidence:{providerEventId:input.providerEventId??input.eventId??null,completedAt:input.completedAt??null,documentHash:input.documentHash??doc.documentHash??null},flags,nextAction,confidenceScore:executionStatus==='executed'?100:executionStatus==='failed_or_voided'?35:70},idempotencyKey}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ {status:'blocked',reason:'leadId, propertyId, dealId, buyerId and documentId are required'} }}

meta.notes: E-signature completion reconciliation is workflow scaffolding. Production use requires verified e-signature provider webhook/event schema, signature evidence, legal document controls, InsulaCRM document schema, and production API contracts.
